crossRefs.note: He took them in his arms, and blessed them, laying his hands on them.
Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them,
But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to…
He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.
